from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document relevant to the filtering task."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title or identifier (e.g. 《判决文书 3》)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated or determined for the case (e.g. 行政给付，民事纠纷，行政协议)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[CaseInfo]
